projects.title: Vinyl Spec

projects.title: DTC Luxury Brand

projects.title: Trail Appliances
projects.details: In-house marketing role at one of Western Canada's largest appliance retailers. Owned email marketing end-to-end — planning, copywriting, layout, segmentation, and A/B testing — contributing to a 20% CTR lift. Also led CMS content updates, paid social creative, and acted as the bridge between social, copy, and dev teams. The SEO work focused on category page optimization and local search visibility across Alberta locations.

projects.title: Fashion Label Launch
projects.details: Zero-to-launch paid acquisition for a new fashion label. Developed the go-to-market audience strategy, wrote and briefed creative, built the testing framework, and scaled winning ads. Within 4 months the brand hit $160K/month in attributed revenue with a 2.8× blended ROAS and a customer base of 6,500+. Managed all creative iteration and budget allocation directly with the founder.

projects.title: 10+ Brands
